description: This PHP class 'Difference' provides methods to compute date differences in various units, supporting array inputs and integrating with PHPSpreadsheet's date utilities.

classes.name: Difference
classes.description: Provides multiple static methods for calculating differences between dates in various units such as days, months, years, etc., with support for array inputs.

methods.name: interval
methods.description: Calculates the interval between two dates in specified units, supporting array inputs and handling different date formats.

methods.name: initialDiff
methods.description: Validates and computes the basic difference between start and end dates, throwing exceptions on invalid input.

methods.name: replaceRetValue
methods.description: Decides whether to assign a result value based on the current unit and comparison key.

methods.name: datedifD
methods.description: Returns the difference in days as an integer.

methods.name: datedifM
methods.description: Calculates the difference in months based on a DateInterval object.

methods.name: datedifMD
methods.description: Calculates the day difference within a month, adjusting for negative differences.

methods.name: datedifY
methods.description: Returns the difference in years based on a DateInterval object.

methods.name: datedifYD
methods.description: Calculates the day difference accounting for leap years and year boundaries.

methods.name: datedifYM
methods.description: Returns the difference in months within a year.
